+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ObservabilityConfig:
+    project_id: str
+    api_key: str
+    base_url: str = "https://api.datadoghq.com"
+    site: str = "datadoghq.com"
+
+
+def load_config() -> ObservabilityConfig:
+    project_id = os.getenv("DATADOG_PROJECT_ID", "").strip()
+    api_key = os.getenv("DD_API_KEY", os.getenv("DATADOG_API_KEY", "")).strip()
+    base_url = os.getenv("DATADOG_API_URL", "https://api.datadoghq.com").strip() or "https://api.datadoghq.com"
+    site = os.getenv("DATADOG_SITE", "datadoghq.com").strip() or "datadoghq.com"
+    if not project_id:
+        raise ValueError("DATADOG_PROJECT_ID is required")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("DD_API_KEY or DATADOG_API_KEY is required")
+    return ObservabilityConfig(project_id=project_id, api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url, site=site)
+
+
+def create_session(config: Optional[ObservabilityConfig] = None) -> requests.Session:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    session = requests.Session()
+    session.headers.update(
+        {
+            "DD-API-KEY": cfg.api_key,
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+            "Accept": "application/json",
+        }
+    )
+    session.base_url = cfg.base_url  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    session.project_id = cfg.project_id  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    session.datadog_site = cfg.site  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return session
+
+
+def api_url(path: str, config: Optional[ObservabilityConfig] = None) -> str:
+    cfg = config or load_config()
+    return f"{cfg.base_url.rstrip('/')}/{path.lstrip('/')}"
+

+    workspace_id = os.getenv("SIGNALFIRE_WORKSPACE_ID")
+    if not api_key or not workspace_id:

+    start_time = end_time - timedelta(minutes=minutes_back)

+    payload = {
+        "workspaceId": workspace_id,
+        "limit": limit,
+        "timeRange": {
+            "start": start_time.isoformat(),
+            "end": end_time.isoformat(),
+        },
+        "filters": [

+                "field": field_name,
+                "operator": "eq",
+                "value": field_value,
+            }

+        "sort": {"field": "timestamp", "direction": "desc"},
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        "Accept": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()

+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+
+import requests
+
+
+def query_error_logs(severity: str, minutes_back: int, limit: int = 50):
+    api_key = os.environ.get("NEW_RELIC_API_KEY")
+    account_id = os.environ.get("NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID")
+    if not api_key or not account_id:
+        raise ValueError("NEW_RELIC_API_KEY and NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID are required")
+
+    since = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=minutes_back)
+    until = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    nrql = (
+        "SELECT timestamp, message, severity FROM Log "
+        f"WHERE severity = '{severity}' "
+        f"SINCE '{since.isoformat()}' UNTIL '{until.isoformat()}' "
+        f"LIMIT {int(limit)}"
+    )
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"https://api.newrelic.com/graphql",
+        headers={
+            "Api-Key": api_key,
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "query": """
+            query($accountId: Int!, $nrql: Nrql!) {
+              actor {
+                account(id: $accountId) {
+                  nrql(query: $nrql) {
+                    results
+                  }
+                }
+              }
+            }
+            """,
+            "variables": {
+                "accountId": int(account_id),
+                "nrql": nrql,
+            },
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return data["data"]["actor"]["account"]["nrql"]["results"]
+

+import json
+import os
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+class DatadogLogsClient:
+    def __init__(self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, site: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
+        self.api_key = api_key or os.getenv("DD_API_KEY")
+        self.site = site or os.getenv("DD_SITE", "datadoghq.com")
+        if not self.api_key:
+            raise ValueError("DD_API_KEY is required")
+
+    def submit_logs(self, logs: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        url = f"https://http-intake.logs.{self.site}/api/v2/logs"
+        headers = {
+            "DD-API-KEY": self.api_key,
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        }
+        response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(logs), timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        return {"status_code": response.status_code, "accepted": True}
+
+

+
+

+
+    event = {

+        "severity": severity,

+
+
